question: A train runs at a speed of 90 km/h in the first 10 minutes and 60 km/h in next 25 minutes and 15 km/h in last 4 minutes. What is the average speed of the train?
solution:
**Formula used:**

Average speed = Total distance / Total time.

**Solution:**

Total distance = (90 km/h × 10/60 h) + (60 km/h × 25/60 h) + (15 km/h × 4/60 h)

⇒ 15 km + 25 km + 1 km = 41 km

Total time = 10/60 h + 25/60 h + 4/60 h

⇒ 39/60 h = 13/20 h

Average speed = Total distance / Total time

⇒ 41 km / (13/20 h) = 41 km × (20/13) h = 820/13 km/h = 63{1 over13}km/h

**Therefore, the average speed of the train is approximately 63{1 over13}km/h.**
